candidates.reason: Unit tests that directly exercise scrapy/contracts/__init__.py (Contract.add_pre_hook, Contract.add_post_hook, ContractsManager); they are the only tests asserting the 'Contracts don't support async callbacks' TypeError that this PR removes, so their expectations must flip to the supported async behaviour.
Covers the `scrapy check` command end to end through ContractsManager in a generated project, which is the path that must now run asynchronous callbacks and return a non-zero exit status on failure.
Tests scrapy.utils.spider.iterate_spider_output(), the helper scrapy/contracts uses to normalize coroutine and async-generator callback results into Deferreds/async iterables for contract counting.
